solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Peerage appear nearly blue taking to Conservative

indicators.note: taking here means the word for blue takes the preceding pieces in front of it
nearly means the word for appear stops one letter short of its end

parts.note: to arise is to appear or come into view
taken as written
blue jokes are racy or risque

explanation.surface: A political boast: the House of Lords looks almost Tory, swinging towards the Conservatives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Blue' looks like the Tory colour, matching the surface, but it means risque. 'Nearly' trims ARISE to ARIS.
explanation.definitionFit: The peerage is the body of nobles, the hereditary ruling class.

clue.text: Excessive unions oddly over America supporting Republican

indicators.note: in a down clue, supporting means the following pieces sit below the letter for Republican
oddly means take the first, third and fifth letters of unions

parts.note: O is the cricket scoring abbreviation for an over
US is short for the United States of America

explanation.surface: A complaint that overbearing labour unions are spreading across America with Republican backing.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruinous costs or demands are crippling ones, beyond what is reasonable.

clue.text: Quarantine giving empty sample, say, in jar

indicators.note: empty means the word sample loses all its inner letters, leaving its outsides
in means the abbreviation for say goes inside the word for jar

parts.note: to jar on someone is to grate on them
EG (for example) is a stock substitute for say

explanation.surface: A medical image: isolating a patient who has produced an empty specimen jar.
explanation.definitionFit: To quarantine people is to separate them off from others, keeping them apart.

clue.text: Language of Greece has arcane meaning initially

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter of each of the five words before it

explanation.surface: A remark that the tongue of ancient Greece holds obscure meanings.
explanation.walkthrough: The Greek setting misleads: the answer is the old Irish script carved on standing stones, which 'Language' covers loosely.
explanation.definitionFit: Ogham is an early medieval Irish writing system, used for the Primitive Irish tongue.

clue.text: Cheese whiff rising, about caught too much!

indicators.note: about means the reversed word wraps around the following pieces
in a down clue, rising means the word for whiff is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: a whiff is a breath of air
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
OTT is short for over the top, too much

explanation.surface: Someone recoils at a cheese whose smell is rising, crying that it is too much.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rising' works only in a down clue, where the reversed word reads upwards; 'too much!' looks like an exclamation but supplies letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Ricotta is a soft Italian whey cheese.

clue.text: Greek character opposed to drink

parts.note: chi is a letter of the Greek alphabet
anti means opposed to

explanation.surface: A Greek figure who disapproves of drinking.
explanation.definitionFit: Chianti is a red wine from Tuscany, so a kind of alcoholic beverage.

clue.text: Spread talk about Old Time Religion's opening

indicators.note: about means the word for talk goes around the following pieces

parts.note: to prate is to talk idly
a prison sentence of life is doing time, so time can mean life

indicators.note: opening means take the first letter of the word Religion's

explanation.surface: A preacher spreads chat about old-time religion, the faith of yesteryear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old Time Religion' reads as a fixed phrase but splits into three pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To proliferate is to multiply rapidly, as something spreading widely.

clue.text: Left over umpteen umbrellas expected after vacation

indicators.note: after vacation means each word has been emptied of its inner letters, leaving only its ends

explanation.surface: Lots of umbrellas remain unclaimed once the holidaymakers have gone.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unused is surplus, remaining because nobody needed it.

clue.text: Smuggled booze before start of Government disposal

indicators.note: before means the word for booze comes ahead of the next piece

parts.note: to run goods is to smuggle them, so smuggled gives the past tense
gin is a spirit, a kind of booze

indicators.note: start of means take the first letter of Government

explanation.surface: Bootleg liquor ahead of a government crackdown and seizure.
explanation.definitionFit: Disposal here is arrangement or setting out in order, as in the disposition of troops.

clue.text: Busy chef acts nice, avoiding extremes

indicators.note: avoiding extremes means each of the three words drops its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A harried cook puts on a pleasant act during service.
explanation.definitionFit: A hectic day is a frantic, crowded one, full of activity.

clue.text: Hidden family fortune detailed end of inheritance

parts.note: a clan is an extended family

indicators.note: detailed means the word for fortune has its tail cut off

parts.note: fortune, as in one's lot or fate, is destiny

indicators.note: end of means take the final letter of inheritance

explanation.surface: A family's fortune laid out in detail at the close of an inheritance case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Detailed' looks like 'set out in detail' but means de-tailed, losing the last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Clandestine dealings are secret ones, kept out of sight.

clue.text: Girl is so mesmerising keeping supple

indicators.note: keeping means the answer is held within the run of words Girl is so mesmerising

explanation.surface: A girl so enchanting that she stays lithe.
explanation.definitionFit: Lissome means lithe and flexible, moving with easy grace.

clue.text: Concerned with morning sickness clutching a container

indicators.note: clutching means the word for sickness holds the following pieces inside it

parts.note: mal is French for illness, familiar from mal de mer
a tin is a metal container

explanation.surface: Morning sickness, with the sufferer clutching a bowl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Morning sickness' reads as one phrase, but the definition ends at 'morning'.
explanation.definitionFit: Matinal is a rare adjective meaning relating to the early part of the day, from French matin.

clue.text: Turns pale seeing fashions clothing sweetheart

indicators.note: clothing means the word for fashions is wrapped around the next piece

parts.note: fads are passing fashions
the heart of the word sweet is its middle letter, E

explanation.surface: Someone blanches at the sight of a lover's fashionable clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Colour fades as it loses brightness and becomes washed out.

clue.text: Yours truly's getting in a state for passion

indicators.note: getting in means the contraction for yours truly goes inside the other pieces

parts.note: a nation is a state
yours truly's means yours truly is, I am, contracted to I'M

explanation.surface: A writer admits to getting worked up into a passionate frenzy.
explanation.definitionFit: Animation is liveliness and spirited feeling, close to ardour.

clue.text: Smart hotshot bottling anger about computer connection

indicators.note: bottling means the other pieces hold the reversed word inside them, as a bottle holds its contents

parts.note: in means fashionable, smart
an ace is an expert, a hotshot

indicators.note: about means the word for anger is turned round

parts.note: to fret is to be vexed or irritated

explanation.surface: A slick operator suppresses fury when wrestling with a computer link.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Smart' looks like the definition (clever) but gives a piece; 'bottling' and 'about' are the two indicators, and 'anger' is fret in its sense of irritation.
explanation.definitionFit: An interface is the point where a computer meets a user or another device.

clue.text: Strong return of Queen implied penning single

indicators.note: return of means the abbreviation for Queen is read backwards

parts.note: ER stands for Elizabeth Regina, Queen Elizabeth

indicators.note: penning means the word for implied encloses the letter for single

parts.note: something implied is unspoken, tacit or silent
I is the Roman numeral one, single

explanation.surface: A firm response from the Queen, hinting at one particular point.
explanation.definitionFit: Resilient means tough and able to bounce back, hence sturdy.

clue.text: Unproductive life's origin in lake under stone

indicators.note: in a down clue, under means the following pieces come beneath the abbreviation for stone

parts.note: st is the abbreviation for stone, the British weight

indicators.note: in means the first letter of life goes inside the name of the lake

parts.note: Erie is one of the Great Lakes

indicators.note: origin means take the first letter of the word life's

explanation.surface: A barren lakebed beneath rock, where life began.
explanation.walkthrough: A stone is a British unit of weight, 14 pounds, abbreviated ST.
explanation.definitionFit: Sterile means barren, incapable of producing young or crops.

clue.text: Culture seen in V&A?

definitions.meaning: V and A are both characters of the alphabet

explanation.surface: Culture on display at the Victoria and Albert Museum.
explanation.walkthrough: The V&A is the Victoria and Albert Museum in London, so the surface is about art; read literally, V and A are just two alphabet characters.
explanation.definitionFit: Letters means scholarship or literary learning, a cultured pursuit.

clue.text: Manage to secure head of stiff brush

indicators.note: to secure means the word for manage holds the next letter fast inside it

parts.note: to cope is to manage

indicators.note: head of means take the first letter of stiff

explanation.surface: Getting by with a firm-bristled brush.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brush' looks like a cleaning tool but here means brushwood, undergrowth.
explanation.definitionFit: A copse is a thicket of small trees, and brush is scrubby undergrowth or brushwood.

clue.text: Timeless copies young lady's almost wearing

indicators.note: wearing means the shortened word for young lady sits inside the abbreviation for copies, as if dressed in it

parts.note: cc stands for carbon copies

indicators.note: almost means the word for young lady loses its last letter

parts.note: a lassie is a young lady; the 's means is, a link

explanation.surface: A girl dressing in imitations of enduring styles.
explanation.definitionFit: A classic work is of lasting quality, never going out of date.

clue.text: First Victorian Prince Consort familiarly

parts.note: Victorian attitudes are prim and proper
Prince Albert, Victoria's consort, shortened familiarly to Al

explanation.surface: A history note on Victoria's husband, the Prince Consort, known affectionately.
explanation.definitionFit: Primal means original or earliest, belonging to the very beginning.

clue.text: Managed walk clenching toes occasionally

indicators.note: clenching means the word for walk grips the chosen letters inside it

parts.note: to tread is to walk

indicators.note: occasionally means take every other letter of toes, starting with the first

explanation.surface: Someone got about by walking with curled-up toes.
explanation.definitionFit: To have treated a matter is to have dealt with or handled it.

clue.text: Starts to display overly tender emotions, say

definitions.text: Starts to display overly tender emotions, say

indicators.note: starts to means take the first letter of each of the five words that follow

explanation.surface: A description of someone gushing with soppy feeling.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines too: one who is too fond shows excessive affection.
explanation.definitionFit: To be doting is to be foolishly fond, showing excessive affection.

clue.text: One doesn't dream about stars?

parts.note: re means about, concerning
the A-list is the top tier of celebrities

explanation.surface: Someone who never fantasises about celebrities or the night sky.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stars' suggests the night sky but means celebrities.
explanation.definitionFit: A pragmatic person accepts how things are and has no idle fancies.

clue.text: Pass on right holding vehicle's first switch

indicators.note: holding means the pieces for pass and right enclose the next letter

parts.note: to pass away is to die

indicators.note: first means take the opening letter of vehicle's

explanation.surface: Overtaking on the right while one car leads, then changing lanes.
explanation.definitionFit: To divert is to switch something onto a different course.

clue.text: Hold back Jack's vessel, circling area

parts.note: Jack is slang for a sailor, as is AB (able seaman), so Jack's gives AB'S

indicators.note: circling means the word for vessel goes round the letter for area

parts.note: a tin is a container, a vessel

explanation.surface: A sailor's ship refuses to proceed, going round an area.
explanation.definitionFit: To abstain is to refrain, holding oneself back from doing something.

clue.text: Grit from shopkeeper's is ten cents

indicators.note: from means the answer is taken out of the run shopkeeper's is ten cents

explanation.surface: A cheap purchase at a corner shop: grit for ten cents.
explanation.definitionFit: Grit is determination and tenacity, refusing to give up.
